title: Twin Vipers
extract:
The Twin Vipers are akimbo  Viper machine pistols of Grineer design, featuring a very high rate of fire, but poor accuracy and extremely poor ammo efficiency. Vipers are the smallest firearms manufactured by the Grineer and boast a simplified magazine design.
Can be sold for  5,000​​​​​​​.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Tied with  Twin Vipers Wraith for fastest fire rate of all secondaries.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Above average burst DPS (456.87)
Above average magazine size (28)
Very high ammo pickup (40)
Very high ammo max (420)
Very high fire rate (25.00 attacks/sec)
Very high disposition (●●●●● (1.45x))
Disadvantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Low accuracy at anything past close range.
Extremely ammo inefficient. Very fast fire rate results in frequent reloading.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Below average crit chance (15.00%)
Low sustained DPS (164.00)
Very low damage per shot (18.27)
Very low total damage (17)
Low accuracy (5.00° to 8.00°)
Low reload speed (2.00 s)
Low status chance (11.00%)
Very low crit multiplier (1.50x)

Acquisition
The Twin Vipers's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Tips
Using the  Pistol Ammo Mutation mod can help regain lost ammo when needed. Alternatively, use  Pistol Scavenger aura or bring along Squad Ammo Restore.
Using short bursts of fire greatly improves accuracy and makes the weapon viable at medium medium-long distances, although it is still advised to be used at close quarters.

Trivia
The Twin Vipers were released on April 12, 2013 with Hotfix 7.7.3 (2013-04-12).
These are probably a reference to the Dual Vipers from Ratchet and Clank as they are the same style of weapon.
